notes.title: "Nobody Expects the Patch V1.3"
notes.notes:
We came back from the dangerous voyage, and brought you back some bounties:


 applied all fixes from other ports (Nintendo Switch & iOS)
 decreased RNG effect (the dice rolls base on the pool of values)
 fixed an intro for Steam Deck (Here Be Dragons is playable on the Steam Deck device)


Have fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33658321/0c4c63d1d3b25a29148a2f418098865b8102715c.gif

notes.title: Here Be Dragons – finally tales the tale… in full version.
notes.notes:
We are happy and proud to invite all of you-wannabe-pirates to witness and experience the full story of Avant Armada.

We would like to thank you for all your support, ideas, suggestions, and patience with some bugs. Over the course of the last few months, we strived to finish the game and offer you the best gameplay possible. We hope you like it. We are looking forward to your reviews, comments, and ideas for the future.

We will support the game as much as possible and will make sure to fix all bugs and issues that you might find.

Sail away, choke the cherub, and do not listen to Polly – the beard is REAL!

notes.title: Patch Fish V0.31 - "Faster Than Catamaran"
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658321/3ac92325cce2de221f9759f8e9bafcd8702b2e38.gif

Please see below details of changes that were introduced in the update.

Patch notes

You asked for it

 Auto Cherub - you don't have to choke the Cherub manually (you can change it in Battle Options). 
 Fast actions - you don't have to click to execute an action (you can change it in Battle Options).
 Fast Compass – speed of phase animation has been increased (you can change it in Battle Options).
 More interesting campaign 3 ("Whale Hunting") - faster & more challenging.
 Faster tutorial - removal of unnecessary texts & less fluff. 
 Added suggestions after defeat in two tutorial battles (1.4 - Island with natives, 2.2 - Pirate Black Christopher).
 Added “Restart” button in Battle Options.
 Added “Restart” button on the Defeat Screen.
 The Cherub spits out dice faster.
 The dice land faster in a free pool.
 Salvos with no damage do not execute.
 Fixed crash when using a die before a free pool was sorted.
 Fixed a word "Heal" in Polish version (using Errata function).
 Added Frame Limiter for powerful GPU.


UI and Effects

 Captain Fish says "Fish!" in Booty Phase; Captain Singer sings in Booty Phase 
 You can skip preparation to battle cutscene (when ships & enemies take their positions) by mouse click
 Blocking the dice in a free pool during Reroll.
 Blocking the dice in a free pool during Assign dice by AI.


Bug Fixes

 Occasional crash in initializing Mermaid's Nest in 6.1 scenario.
 Too long pause between die's explosion and showing a hit.
 T-pose sailors animation in the Tavern.
 Mermaid's hair no longer change colour.
 Increased click area for Island with natives.
 Camera glitch in transition during back from combat screen to campaign screen.
 UI glitch in transition during first Salvos in 1.1 scenario.


We are very sorry, but we can't add Undo option in this update. It's almost ready, but not stable enough. We will add it as soon as possible. 

Please let us know if the game plays better and we very much appreciate all your feedback and additional ideas.

We will be focused on new content from now on. The time has come for you to meet infamous, blood-thirsty, ruthless Captain Blackbeard.

Stay tuned.

notes.title: Captain's log - Day 11 - "Changes on horizon"
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658321/7abc4a7870fe5950637a094c7814650d2afddf4b.gif

Journey continues. I started drinking again.
Navigator and Polly are competing every day trying to be the best in annoying me with their constant moaning and screaming. If things don't improve in next couple of days we will have vacancy for Navigator. And parrot...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658321/a862b331090740356b64d0ba7f1cf86f5e23a573.png

As promised, we are working very hard to introduce certain changes. We plan to release an update this week (hopefully Friday, if Captain doesn't jump out from the ship), that would address some of your proposals and concerns (listed in previous entry). 

We will provide details of changes in next announcement, but for now wanted to leave you with this small preview of upcoming changes in the gif above.
